title: The Horizontal Sanitary Tee Mistake
description: Using a sanitary tee on a horizontal-to-horizontal waste pipe transition is a frequent mistake that leads to chronic blockages. Sanitary tees are designed primarily for vertical-to-horizontal transitions where gravity assists flow direction. On a horizontal branch, the tight turn of a sanitary tee fails to direct solid waste properly, causing debris to accumulate upstream and restrict flow. Professional installations require a combination wye and 1/8 bend or a long-sweep turn to maintain smooth, continuous flow velocity. Always check your local plumbing code for approved fitting orientations.
